info.name: Create a new Engagement from a template

items.docs: Creates a new Engagement based on an existing template Engagement. The request is accepted for asynchronous processing; the response returns the new Engagement's UUID, which may not be fully provisioned immediately.

info.name: Export an Engagement binder

params.name: uuid
params.description: The UUID of the Engagement to export

items.docs:
Begins a long-running process that will generate an Engagement binder as a zip file.

Use the Job ID that this endpoint returns with the appropriate [jobs endpoint](#/jobs/get_job_v1) to check its status and get its result.

info.name: Fetch a generated Engagement binder report

params.name: uuid
params.description: The UUID of the Job

items.docs: Returns the download URL and metadata for a completed Engagement binder export. Call this once the export Job returned by the export endpoint has finished.

info.name: List Milestones that belong to the specified Engagement

params.name: engagement_uuid
params.description: The UUID of the Engagement to retrieve Milestones for

params.name: associated_engagement_status
params.description: Filter by the optional Engagement lifecycle phase associated with each Milestone. This is not the Engagement's current status and does not determine Milestone completion.

params.name: client_can_view
params.description: Filter Milestones by client visibility.

params.name: is_completed
params.description: Filter by completion state. A completed Milestone has a non-null `completed_at` value.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Field used to sort Milestones. Results are sorted by creation time unless `sequence` is requested.

params.name: sort_order
params.description: Sort order for paginated results. Use `desc` to reverse the default ascending order.

items.docs: List Milestones that belong to the specified Engagement
